column3: A big armoured knight in a heavy diving helmet, shield on his left arm, lifts a long heavy oar high over his head with his right hand and slams it straight down onto the ground in front of him with all his weight, then plants his feet and steadies.
A heavy armoured knight with a shield raised on his left arm makes one short, compact forward jab with a club in his right hand, then returns to a guarded stance.
A big, calm, weathered sailor knight plants a long oar upright beside him, lifts his left fist slowly to the sky in a quiet, proud salute, then rests both hands on the oar.
A slender, precise woman holds a longbow in her left hand, smoothly draws an arrow back to her cheek with her right hand, aims for a moment and releases the shot, then lowers the bow.
A light, agile woman quickly dives into a forward roll to the side and springs back up onto her feet into a low ready crouch.
A slender woman is struck hard in the chest, staggers backward two steps, drops to her knees and collapses onto her side on the ground and lies still.
A poised woman sweeps her right hand across her body as if pulling a long thread through the air, then thrusts her open palm forward and holds the pose with cold focus.
